message: Astra: Within Fa na’s scene, you intended to “explore her true thoughts and intentions”; which words in the resulting monologue accomplish that? What remains uncertain about its contribution? Why would further thinking resolve that uncertainty better than an informative drafting attempt, and what would make acting now premature? What textual evidence would let you stop checking? Could you briefly state your finding and chosen next intention in English, then carry out that choice?

perception.quote: explore her true thoughts and intentions
